name: k3 Forward + Soft-Clipped Asymmetric Backward
tagline: Straight-through estimator: forward returns clamped k3, backward sees a saturating quadratic with a 1.15x boost when the policy under-weights the reference.
init_recovers: k3 baseline in the forward direction (logged value)
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid of k3 (forward value) and a saturating-quadratic surrogate (backward gradient). Unlike k3 which would otherwise drive both directions identically, the backward term gets +15% gain when r<0 and saturates at ~c=2 instead of growing like e^{-r}.

name: Sigmoid-Sharp k2/k3 Asymmetric Blend
tagline: Per-token convex combination alpha*k3 + (1-alpha)*k2 with alpha = sigmoid(-3*(logp - logp_ref)) so positive deviations use k2 (mode-seeking brake) and negative use k3.
init_recovers: k2 baseline at d=+inf; k3 baseline at d=-inf; (k2+k3)/2 at d=0
diff_from_baseline: Combines the k2 and k3 baselines with a sigmoid switch alpha=sigma(-3 d). For d>0 alpha->0 (k2 dominates, larger penalty), for d<0 alpha->1 (k3 dominates, milder).

name: Piecewise k3 (mode-collapse) / k2 (over-opt)
tagline: Hard switch: k2 when log p > log q (over-optimization), k3 when log p <= log q (mode collapse), clamped to [-10, 10].
init_recovers: Exactly k2 when log p > log q; exactly k3 when log p <= log q
diff_from_baseline: Hard piecewise mix of the k2 and k3 baselines selected by sign(log p - log q): forward-KL surrogate (k2) for over-optimization side, reverse-KL surrogate (k3) for mode-collapse side. C^2 at zero because both share the same second derivative.

name: STE Cubic-Quadratic / Bounded Log-Cosh
tagline: Forward is a smooth blend of (0.5 d^2 + 0.05 d^3) on the positive side and 0.35*k3 on the negative; backward uses a 3-clipped k2 plus log-cosh surrogate.
formula:
$$d = \log\pi - \log\pi_{\text{ref}},\ b = \sigma(4d)$$
$$f^+ = 0.5\,d_+^{2} + 0.05\,d_+^{3},\ f^- = 0.35\,(e^{-d_-} + d - 1)$$
$$\text{forward} = b f^+ + (1-b) f^-$$
$$\text{surrogate} = \tfrac{1}{2}(\min(d_+,3))^{2} + 3\,(d_+ - 3)_+ + 0.30\,\tau^{2}\log\cosh(d_-/\tau),\ \tau=2.5$$
$$\widehat{\mathrm{KL}} = \mathrm{clip}\bigl(\text{forward.detach()} + \text{surrogate} - \text{surrogate.detach()},\,0,\,10\bigr)$$
init_recovers: Approximately k2 near d=0 (matches second derivative)
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid asymmetric estimator: forward-value path is a (k2+cubic) on d>0 and down-weighted k3 on d<0, blended by a sigmoid; backward-gradient path is a separately defined k2-clipped + log-cosh surrogate via a straight-through trick. Distinct from any of k1/k2/k3/abs.

name: C1-Truncated k3 (Linear Tails)
tagline: k3 inside |r|<=2 and a C^1 linear extrapolation outside, so the gradient saturates at +/- (e^2 - 1) and +/- (e^{-2} - 1).
formula:
$$r = \log\pi_{\text{ref}} - \log\pi,\ \delta = 2$$
$$k_3(r) = e^{r} - r - 1$$
$$\widehat{\mathrm{KL}}(r) = \begin{cases} (e^{\delta}-1)(r-\delta) + e^{\delta}-3 & r>\delta\\ (e^{-\delta}-1)(r+\delta) + e^{-\delta}+1 & r<-\delta\\ k_3(r) & |r|\le\delta \end{cases}$$
diff_from_baseline: Modifies the k3 baseline by replacing its tails with a C^1 linear continuation outside |r|<=2; values and gradients match k3 at the boundary, gradients are bounded outside.
